label: place names: the city you live in, and the country
note: Covered by HI-C68-country, HI-C68-india and HI-C68-city: `desh`, the country name `Bharat`, and `shahar`, the form field both mocks' writing papers require. No settlement name below the country is taught, so a candidate can write the city LABEL but must supply their own city as a proper noun.
